sample_unit: LLM-generated synthetic cases and differential diagnosis lists

links.outcome: Racial bias in differential diagnosis ranking across race-varied prompts, standalone vs agentic workflow
links.effect: DeepSeek V3 in an agentic workflow improved 0.0348 in mean p-value, 0.1166 in median p-value, and 0.0949 in mean difference versus standalone, though not uniform across every metric.
links.quote: When embedded in an agentic workflow, DeepSeek V3 showed an improvement of 0.0348 in mean p-value, 0.1166 in median p-value, and 0.0949 in mean difference relative to the standalone model, although improvement was not uniform across every metric.

links.outcome: Deviation of LLM-generated synthetic patient cases from observed US race-stratified epidemiological distributions
links.effect: All five models deviated from observed racial distributions in synthetic case generation; GPT-4.1 showed the smallest overall deviation.
links.quote: All models deviated from observed racial distributions in the synthetic case generation task, with GPT-4.1 showing the smallest overall deviation.

unlisted_practices: Retrieval-based agentic workflow to mitigate explicit racial bias in LLM diagnosis

screen.practice: agentic retrieval workflow for bias mitigation
screen.reason: Empirically assesses racial bias in medical LLMs across case generation and differential diagnosis, and tests whether an agentic workflow mitigates explicit bias compared to standalone LLM execution.
